sentence: This project studies how rolling and sealing each layer during laser powder-bed fusion changes the structure and strength of tungsten parts.
This project builds a degree option and a certificate program with courses on machine learning, natural language processing, computer vision, and AI ethics.
This project builds control programs for robots and ways to check that the programs are safe before the robots use them.
This project builds an automated system that maps the fronts of marine-terminating glaciers in Greenland from satellite imagery.
This project builds a data system that combines data streams from many sources and uses machine learning to answer questions and watch for events.
This project studies how protons and neutrons interact in rare isotopes that have far more neutrons than protons and are weakly bound.
This project builds a monitoring framework that checks the quality of Internet traffic data and shares labeled datasets for machine learning in cybersecurity.
This project plans a research center that will make materials for solar panels, batteries and biofuel and explore biodiesel production.
This project builds computer models to understand how large single-crystal diamonds grow under high pressure and high temperature.
This project studies how people and artificial intelligence can work as a team in automated vehicles, including how much they trust each other.
This project tries to find out what genes do by studying how they cluster together in three-dimensional space in the nucleus of a green alga.
This project builds a hardware accelerator and compiler that speed up cryptography for processing private data without trusting the cloud.
This project studies how different microbiomes mix and reassemble, using sourdough starters, kombucha and fermented vegetables as test systems.
This project builds small on-chip devices that detect and produce microwave signals to help control and read out superconducting quantum computers.
This project studies how a plant virus senses the insect that carries it and which tomato genes help.
